deploy-bot: Terraform apply started — env=production-dc4, workspace=infra-dc4, tag=v2.1.0, sha=0f3a9b4. Plan: +12 ~3 -1. Command: ```terraform apply -auto-approve -var=env=production-dc4```

maria: Hold up — there's a running migration on db-dc4 by @devon. Can we pause the apply?

devon: Yep, that's mine. ETA ~5m for final migration step. Please hold, thanks.

deploy-bot: Hold request received from maria. Pausing apply; will wait for explicit `resume` or timeout 30m. Use `@deploy-bot resume 1748112233` to continue.

ops-bot: Tagging resource group infra/dc4 with `rollout.blocked=true` — prevent automated rollouts.

devon: migration finished — all good from DB side, resuming now. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Resuming apply for 1748112233... Running steps (7/16) module.vpc.aws_route.main update.

deploy-bot: Apply completed with 2 warnings. Outputs: vpc_id = vp-0abc123. Duration: 4m22s.

monitoring-bot: ALERT — service `router` (dc4) 5xx rate spike 4.2% > threshold 2.0% detected 60s after rollout. Initiating auto-rollback per policy `safety.autorollback=enabled`.

deploy-bot: Auto-rollback initiated — reverting to previous infrastructure state (rollback tag v2.0.9, sha=9c7b2a1). Running `terraform apply` to revert route changes.

deploy-bot: Rollback completed successfully. Status: success. Reverted changeset applied, duration 3m12s.

maria: Thanks — keeping the rollback for now. I'll open a follow-up PR to pin provider `hashicorp/aws = "~> 4.58.0"` and add a route drain to avoid the 5xx spike.

devon: Sounds good. I'll put the follow-up branch `infra/dc4/fix-route-drain` up and link the PR.

ops-bot: Noted. If monitoring sees another spike, escalate to on-call and file an incident.
